nodes.label: Reflection Journal glossary (GLOSSARY.md)
nodes.rationale: Vocabulary for issues, ADRs, and agent output; use these terms, don't drift to synonyms.

nodes.label: Business logic in namespaced classes/
nodes.rationale: Business logic lives in namespaced classes/; lib.php stays a thin bridge. GPL header + @package/@copyright/@license + PHPDoc on every PHP file; schema/capability change bumps version.php + db/upgrade.php savepoint (CI checks).

nodes.label: Never modify Moodle core
nodes.rationale: moodle/ is a checkout and must never be modified or committed; work in the plugin dir only.

nodes.label: Security guardrails
nodes.rationale: $DB API with param placeholders only; no raw SQL with user input; input via required_param/optional_param; writes behind require_sesskey(); require_login + require_capability on every route; walk docs/security-checklist.md per diff.

nodes.label: phpcs zero findings criterion
nodes.rationale: phpcs with the moodle standard must stay at zero findings - declared success criterion for the project.

nodes.label: Pinned moodle-docker clone (commit f0583ec)
nodes.rationale: The dev stack is an upstream moodle-docker clone outside the repo, pinned to a commit so every machine reproduces the verified baseline (ADR-0003); currently pinned f0583ec, verified 2026-11-23 with Moodle 5.3.1+ / PHP 8.3 / PostgreSQL 17; record new pins here and in docs/tech-stack.md.

nodes.label: docker/ holds only override files
nodes.rationale: Deliberate: only env.sh and local.yml.example override files live here; the stack itself is the pinned upstream clone (ADR-0003).

nodes.label: ADR practice (lightweight ADRs in docs/adr/)
nodes.rationale: Repo is developed agent-first across many cold-start sessions; decisions and reasoning vanish unless written down. Lightweight per-decision files (context, decision, alternatives, consequences) avoid relitigation and stale heavyweight docs; anything deviating from the core ledger requires an ADR before implementation.

nodes.label: Moodle 5.3 LTS target (MOODLE_503_STABLE)
nodes.rationale: A portfolio plugin must target a version a reviewer would deploy, with a support window outliving the application process. 5.2 rejected (non-LTS, security support ends Oct 2027), 4.5 LTS rejected (pre-public/ layout, ageing APIs), main/6.0 rejected (moving target). PHP 8.3 floor with 8.4 in CI, PostgreSQL 17 (minimum raised from 15), Node 22 LTS, $plugin->requires = 2026100500.

nodes.label: docker/ override-files-only rule
nodes.rationale: docker/ contains only small override files: env.sh (sourced exports), local.yml.example (plugin bind mount), README.md — no vendored copy of moodle-docker.

nodes.label: Pinned moodle-docker clone outside the repo (f0583ec)
nodes.norm_label: pinned moodle-docker clone outside the repo (f0583ec)
nodes.rationale: Vendoring moodle-docker's compose files forks upstream config that must be re-diffed on every upstream change; updates via git pull in a pinned clone are cleaner. The repo alone cannot boot the environment — acceptable for a dev-only, gitignored concern.

nodes.label: Repo root = plugin root
nodes.rationale: Marketplace requirement: the plugin must be clonable straight into mod/ (repo root = plugin root); separate plugin + env repos and plugin-in-subdirectory-with-symlink rejected.

nodes.label: Plugin bind mount via pinned clone's local.yml
nodes.norm_label: plugin bind mount via pinned clone's local.yml
nodes.rationale: The plugin repo sits outside the core checkout, so it must appear inside the container at /var/www/html/public/mod/reflectjournal without copying files or editing core. Symlink into moodle/ dangles inside the container (bind mounts can't follow paths outside the mounted tree); copy/sync drifts; nesting the repo inside moodle/public/mod/ inverts the plugin-at-root layout (ADR-0003) — all rejected.

nodes.label: Anonymous shadow volumes for repo-local moodle/ and ci/
nodes.norm_label: anonymous shadow volumes for repo-local moodle/ and ci/
nodes.rationale: Without shadow volumes, Behat init regenerates the classmap over the nested core copy and dies with 'Cannot declare interface behat_session_interface' (verified 2026-11-23).

nodes.label: In-container PHPUnit + Behat testing
nodes.rationale: Tests must prove real Moodle behaviour (DB, forms, completion, gradebook) and run locally in WSL2 without host PHP setup; agents need local proof to self-correct, so CI-only is rejected; third-party runners lack Moodle's fixtures/generators. Behat CI uses Chrome, local Firefox — both stock profiles.

nodes.label: GitHub Actions CI via moodle-plugin-ci (MOODLE_503_STABLE x PHP 8.3/8.4 x pgsql/mariadb)
nodes.norm_label: github actions ci via moodle-plugin-ci (moodle_503_stable x php 8.3/8.4 x pgsql/mariadb)
nodes.rationale: Gates every push; workflow modelled on moodle-plugin-ci gha.dist.yml (4.5.11); both DBs from M0 is a success criterion; steps phplint, phpmd (advisory), phpcs (max-warnings 0), phpdoc, validate, savepoints, mustache, grunt, phpunit, behat.

nodes.label: Flag ADR conflicts explicitly
nodes.rationale: If output contradicts an existing ADR, surface it explicitly (e.g. 'Contradicts ADR-0007, but worth reopening because...') rather than silently overriding.

nodes.label: Domain docs reading convention
nodes.rationale: Before exploring, read GLOSSARY.md (or GLOSSARY-MAP.md) at the repo root and the docs/adr/ entries touching the area; if absent, proceed silently — the /domain-modeling skill creates them lazily when terms or decisions get resolved.

nodes.label: Use the glossary's vocabulary
nodes.rationale: Output must use terms as defined in GLOSSARY.md, not synonyms; a missing term signals either invented language (reconsider) or a real gap (note it for /domain-modeling).

nodes.label: feedback
nodes.rationale: Teacher's private response stored on the entry row; distinct from the grade.

nodes.label: gradebook
nodes.rationale: Grades flow via grade_update(), no custom table.

nodes.label: GitHub issue tracker (jeius/moodle-mod_reflectjournal via gh CLI)
nodes.norm_label: github issue tracker (jeius/moodle-mod_reflectjournal via gh cli)
nodes.rationale: All operations via gh; infer repo from git remote; file issues only into the user's own repo and verify with gh repo view before the first gh issue create in a fork; PRs as a triage/request surface set to no.

nodes.label: Native issue dependencies (blocked-by edges)
nodes.rationale: Canonical, UI-visible blocking via gh blocked-by edges (database ids via the dependencies API); fallback 'Blocked by:' body line; a ticket is unblocked when every blocker is closed; count open blockers with issue_dependencies_summary.blocked_by.

nodes.label: Wayfinding operations (map + child tickets)
nodes.rationale: Used by /wayfinder: a single map issue labelled wayfinder:map holding Notes/Decisions-so-far/Fog, child issues as tickets (wayfinder:<type> labels); frontier query lists open unblocked unassigned children in map order; claim assigns @me; resolve comments, closes, and appends a context pointer to Decisions-so-far; a map's destination is usually a spec, handing off to /to-spec.

nodes.label: Canonical triage roles mapped to tracker labels
nodes.norm_label: canonical triage roles mapped to tracker labels
nodes.rationale: Five canonical triage roles map 1:1 to tracker label strings: needs-triage (maintainer evaluates), needs-info (waiting on reporter), ready-for-agent (fully specified, ready for an AFK agent), ready-for-human (requires human implementation), wontfix (will not be actioned).

nodes.label: Spec/plan publication overrides
nodes.rationale: Canonical spec is a committed file specs/NNN-slug.md; '/to-spec' writes the file then a parent issue that only summarizes and links (no ready-for-agent on the parent — tickets only); '/to-tickets' tickets carry a 'Spec: specs/NNN-slug.md' line and keep native blocked-by edges; these override the skills' publication defaults.

nodes.label: Graphify knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: Snapshot of docs + code in graphify-out/ (graph.html, GRAPH_REPORT.md, graph.json). Query before grepping for questions spanning documents (query/affected/path/explain); it can lag the working tree so the source file wins; refresh only on user request via /graphify . --update.

nodes.label: Known issues (PHPUnit re-init after Behat, doc 404s, port 8000, never docker down)
nodes.norm_label: known issues (phpunit re-init after behat, doc 404s, port 8000, never docker down)

nodes.label: Worktrees disabled (bind-mount; sequential subagents)
nodes.rationale: The moodle-docker stack bind-mounts this exact path (ADR-0004); a worktree anywhere else is invisible to containers; work in place, one feature branch, never on main; rejected docker-override alternative in ADR-0006.

nodes.label: Canonical spec file (docs/specs/NNN-slug.md)
nodes.rationale: Provides the stable artifact between idea and code: it lands on main through a small docs PR before tickets are cut so tickets link a stable path; the GitHub parent issue links to it and does not duplicate it; specs are committed and never deleted so the repo itself demonstrates the process.

nodes.label: code-review
nodes.rationale: It searches repo-root specs/ and docs/ alike for a spec, so moving specs under docs/specs/ preserves discoverability - the basis of the 2026-11-23 amendment.

nodes.label: finishing-a-development-branch
nodes.rationale: Default three integration options narrowed: the expected choice is 'push and create a PR', and the merge itself happens on GitHub by the user (preference note in docs/workflow.md phase 7).

nodes.label: Per-ticket implementation plan (docs/plans/<issue#>-slug.md)
nodes.rationale: Agent-written with the superpowers:writing-plans template plus front matter, and committed as the first commit of the ticket's PR so the PR reads spec -> plan -> code.

nodes.label: subagent-driven-development
nodes.rationale: Its 'never start on main' rule still applies via the feature-branch requirement, and it already forbids parallel implementers, which makes strictly sequential subagent implementers in the single shared tree safe.

nodes.label: to-spec
nodes.rationale: Default (publish the spec as a tracker issue with ready-for-agent) is overridden to: canonical file docs/specs/NNN-slug.md plus a link-stub parent issue with no ready-for-agent label. Mechanism: AGENTS.md prefs + docs/agents/issue-tracker.md, the tracker doc the skill consults.

nodes.label: using-git-worktrees
nodes.rationale: Its Step 0 explicitly honors a worktree preference declared in instructions, which is the mechanism that makes the work-in-place override in AGENTS.md legitimate instead of a fight with the skill.

nodes.label: writing-plans
nodes.rationale: Default plan location docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<feature>.md is overridden to docs/plans/<issue#>-slug.md; the skill itself says user preferences override the location.

nodes.label: Spec body template (/to-spec sections)
nodes.rationale: The body keeps /to-spec's own template - same sections, same order (Problem Statement, Solution, User Stories, Implementation Decisions, Testing Decisions, Out of Scope, Further Notes); do not invent a second template. Repo note: no specific file paths or code snippets (they go stale), with one exception - a prototype snippet that encodes a decision more precisely than prose may be inlined, trimmed to the decision-rich parts. Testing decisions target the highest existing seam: service classes in classes/, Behat for UI journeys.

nodes.label: ADR-0006: Spec/plan workflow replaces per-task prompts
nodes.norm_label: adr-0006: spec/plan workflow replaces per-task prompts

nodes.label: Git worktrees disabled (work in place on one feature branch)
nodes.norm_label: git worktrees disabled (work in place on one feature branch)
nodes.rationale: The dev stack bind-mounts exactly this path (ADR-0004), so a worktree in another directory is not seen by the containers and PHPUnit/Behat would execute against the wrong tree. The alternative - a docker override mounting each worktree - was rejected: it means editing local.yml in the pinned moodle-docker clone per branch and stacks per-branch state on top of the shadow-volume trick ADR-0004 already needs. superpowers:using-git-worktrees Step 0 honors a declared preference, so the override lives in AGENTS.md. Consequence: subagent implementers run strictly sequentially in the one tree.

nodes.label: Parent issue as link stub (no ready-for-agent)
nodes.norm_label: parent issue as link stub (no ready-for-agent)
nodes.rationale: The GitHub parent issue links to the spec and never duplicates it; the ready-for-agent label is reserved for tickets only, so the parent is a link stub and not agent-grabbable work.

nodes.label: Per-task prompt workflow (docs/tasks/ + docs/task-template.md)
nodes.rationale: Rejected and removed (user call, 2026-11-23): no canonical spec layer, no stable link targets, process invisible in the repo. Its M1 scope lives on in docs/plan.md.

nodes.label: Seven-phase workflow (decide, spec, tickets, plan, execute, PR, merge)
nodes.norm_label: seven-phase workflow (decide, spec, tickets, plan, execute, pr, merge)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the M0 per-task-prompt workflow: that gave no canonical artifact between idea and code, no spec layer for tickets to link, no stable path a PR could reference, and left the process invisible in the repo - weak as portfolio evidence, which is one of the project's goals. Phases 1-3 run by the user (skills are user-invoked via disable-model-invocation), phases 4-6 by the agent, merge by the user; one skill per phase where skills overlap.

nodes.label: End-of-task gate
nodes.rationale: Every task ends with all of: phpcs at zero findings, user-visible text only via lang strings (get_string(), never hardcoded), a docs/security-checklist.md walk of the task's diff (capability checks, require_sesskey() on writes, required_param/optional_param cleaning), version.php bump + db/upgrade.php savepoint if schema or capabilities changed (CI checks this), and a cache purge via $MOODLE_DOCKER_BIN.

nodes.label: Highest existing seam
nodes.rationale: Test through the service classes in classes/, Behat for UI flows; new seams are proposed in the spec (/to-spec step 2), never invented in a plan - the ideal number of new seams is zero.

nodes.label: Name the core API
nodes.rationale: Every mechanism in the plan names the Moodle core API it uses, matching the ledger in docs/architecture.md (e.g. grade_update, core_privacy metadata provider); a mechanism with no core API needs an ADR before the plan is written, not during execution - this is the core-API-first principle applied at plan level.

nodes.label: Plan lifecycle (first commit of PR; ready -> in-progress -> done)
nodes.norm_label: plan lifecycle (first commit of pr; ready -> in-progress -> done)
nodes.rationale: The plan is committed as the first commit of the ticket's PR so the PR reads spec -> plan -> code; plans are kept forever and done plans stay as portfolio evidence of the workflow.

nodes.label: Test-first, always
nodes.rationale: Every feature task starts with a failing test: PHPUnit for logic (via the plugin's PHPUnit data generator, tests/generator.php), Behat only for UI journeys; watch the test fail before writing implementation code (superpowers:test-driven-development).

nodes.label: Repo-specific overrides on /to-spec
nodes.rationale: The canonical artifact is the spec file, not a tracker issue: /to-spec's default ('publish the spec to the issue tracker') becomes writing docs/specs/NNN-slug.md and filing a parent issue that links it. The parent issue gets no ready-for-agent label - that label is for tickets cut by /to-tickets.

nodes.label: Spec lifecycle (draft -> approved -> on main -> implemented)
nodes.norm_label: spec lifecycle (draft -> approved -> on main -> implemented)
nodes.rationale: Draft written by the user via /to-spec (synthesizing the /wayfinder or /grill-with-docs conversation; it does not interview); approved flips front matter and files a parent issue linking the spec; the spec lands on main through a small docs PR before tickets are cut so tickets reference a stable path; implemented when all tickets cut from it are merged. Specs are kept forever as portfolio evidence.

nodes.rationale: Single line '@AGENTS.md' — CLAUDE.md delegates entirely to AGENTS.md.

nodes.rationale: docs/task-template.md and the superseded docs/tasks/ prompts removed; docs/workflow.md added; AGENTS.md rewritten.

nodes.label: One canonical skill per phase
nodes.rationale: grill-with-docs = grilling + domain-modeling + doc creation; SDD gives one fresh implementer per task plus a spec-compliance + quality review loop; implement-spec breaks one-PR-per-ticket and the no-parallel-writers rule; writing-plans examples are TypeScript-specific so Moodle's plan gates live in plans/README.md; requesting-code-review is the reviewer SDD already uses.

nodes.label: Git worktrees disabled (work in place)
nodes.rationale: The docker stack bind-mounts this exact path, so work in place: one feature branch at a time, never on main; sequential subagent implementers only, never two writers in this tree at once.
